query:
select
to_char(((datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Prescription date",
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
age as "Age",
sex as "Sex",
village as "Village",
facility as "Facility",
is_selected_for_discharge as "Prescription selected for discharge",
medication_code as "Code",
medication as "Medication",
route as "Route",
quantity as "Quantity",
repeats as "Repeats",
is_ongoing as "Is ongoing",
is_prn as "Is PRN",
is_variable_dose as "Is variable dose",
dose_amount as "Dose amount",
units as "Units",
frequency as "Frequency"
from "reporting"."ds__encounter_prescriptions"
where
((datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) >= 
:fromDate
and ((datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) <= 
:toDate
and case when 
:facilityId is null then true
else facility_id = 
:facilityId
end
order by datetime desc
name: Prescription line list
notes: This report generates a list of all prescription created in the selected date range. Prescriptions are listed in order of most recent prescribed date and time.
